title: Stack Overflow Annual Developer Survey 2024
hook: This week's dataset is derived from the 2024 Stack Overflow Annual Developer Survey. Conducted in May 2024, the survey gathered responses from over 65,000 developers across seven key sections: 1. Basic information 2. Education, work, and career 3. Tech and tech culture 4. Stack Overflow community 5. Artificial Intelligence (AI) 6. Professional Developer Series - Not part of the main survey 7. Thoughts on Survey The dataset provided for this analysis focuses exclusively on the single-response questions from the main survey sections. Each categorical response in the survey has been integer-coded, with corresponding labels available in the crosswalk file. What can you see about developer demographics? How do developers engage with Stack Overflow? What do they think about AI?
